name: Game
lead: The game version a room runs, its entity kinds, blocks and items, and the pack's own blocks, items and recipes: the `game` global, or `room.game`.

functions.name: block
functions.description: Returns one block in this version's numbers, or nil for a name this game has no word for.

functions.name: item
functions.description: Returns an item this game has, or nil for a name it does not; never an error.

functions.name: texture
functions.description: Returns a new texture of width by height pixels, see-through until drawn on, for a pack's block or item.

fields.name: world_height
fields.description: How tall the world is in blocks: 128, or 256 for a 1.8.9 world.

fields.name: sea_level
fields.description: The y of this world's sea level.

fields.name: entities
fields.description: The kinds of entity: `define` a pack's own, `amend` the game's own, and read a kind of the game: a mob kind by either spelling (`game.entities.cow`, `game.entities.Cow`), a kind that is not a mob by its name (`game.entities.arrow`); nil where the game has none. It iterates every kind, including pack definitions: `for name, kind in game.entities do`.

fields.name: blocks
fields.description: The one table that *adds* to a version rather than reading it.

fields.name: biomes
fields.description: Biomes of the pack's own: a vanilla biome with other colours and weather.

fields.name: recipes
fields.description: What a crafting grid and a furnace make of a pack's items; recipes are added while the pack loads.

fields.name: items
fields.description: Defines items of the pack's own, with a texture for clients from 1.21.4.

fields.name: terrain
fields.description: What this world's overworld is made of: `snow` and `steps`, as citadel.yml writes them; read-only, nil when there is no list.

title: game global · type Game
